name: robots/mrpt__mvsim
title: MVSim vehicle through MVSim's services
intro: MVSim vehicle through MVSim's services, adapted from mrpt/mvsim. It reads `read_pose`; runs `set_twist`. `set_twist`: hand one twist setpoint (vx, wz) to the vehicle's controller through MVSim's set_controller_twist service; the setpoint persists until another command. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/mrpt__mvsim --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/mrpt__mvsim --backend fake --mcp
